To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) utilization rate is one of the most important parameters in cloud computing cost effectiveness analysis; 2) utilization rates above 50% should be considered for cloud computing cost effectiveness; 3) utilization rate is not the only parameter in cloud computing cost analysis; 4) other technical parameters should be also considered in cost analysis.
cloud computing cost efficiency is highly dependent on the utilization rate and that the utilization rate should be considered in the cost-benefit analysis of cloud computing adoption.
only very high CPU utilization rates can financially support the on-premise IT resource decision.

the question of how the cost-effectiveness of cloud computing services can be measured and what are the main factors influencing this measure.
